sex.Description: sex of the participant as reported by the participant

group.Description: experimental group the participant belonged to

site.Description: site where the scans were obtained

ksqi_score.Description: total score obtained on the sleep quality section of the ksq

kss_score_baseline.Description: score obtained on kss questionnaire at baseline

kss_score_followup.Description: score obtained on kss questionnaire at follow-up

pvt_meanrt_baseline.Description: mean reaction speed of the pvt test at baseline

pvt_meanrt_followup.Description: mean reaction speed of the pvt test at follow-up

chronotype.Description: chronotype of the participant as reported by the participant
